version: sim v2 (EH-diagnostic; 2026-05-20) — 3-season window 2023-24 → 2025-26 with weights {1.00, 0.60, 0.25}, 16-season RAPM unchanged, ±3.0 cap, 300-EV-min threshold; R1=split C3 into off/def, R5=D-asymmetric C2 (25/25/25/25 with defensive sub-metric), R2=SH points/60 sub-B in PK, R4=expected_gp_share availability column

components.rapm: 16-season RAPM total (year-weighted, goalie-adjusted), global z, weight 0.20
components.individual: Forwards: ixG/60 (0.40) + iHDCF/60 (0.30) + iGSAX/60 (0.30). Defensemen (EH-diagnostic R5): 0.25 each of ixG/60, iHDCF/60, iGSAX/60, and on-ice xGA/60 (inverted, position-relative). All blended z (40 global / 60 pos-rel); weight 0.33
components.relative_xgf: EH-diagnostic R1 — 50/50 split: 50% offensive (on-ice xGF/60 vs off-ice team xGF/60, blended z) + 50% defensive (on-ice xGA/60 vs off-ice team xGA/60, inverted, blended z). Weight 0.17
components.playmaking: 70% primary-assists/60 (40/60 blended z) + 30% points/60 global z, 3-season window, weight 0.18
components.power_play: 50/50 blend of PP on-ice xGF/60 (5on4) and individual PP goals above expected, 3-season window, blended z; weight 0.07; min 60 PP min
components.penalty_kill: EH-diagnostic R2 — 70/30 blend: 70% on-ice xGA/60 at 4on5 inverted + 30% individual SH points/60 (G+A1+A2). Both blended z over PK-qualified pool. Weight 0.05; min 60 PK min

expected_gp_share: EH-diagnostic R4 — year-weighted average of games_played/82 over the 3-season window (denominator = sum of season weights × 82 = 151.7); seasons not played count as 0 GP. For Phase 4 to multiply against composite_war for availability-adjusted team strength.

fixes_applied.fix2: Component 5 = 50/50 blend of on-ice PP xGF/60 + individual PP goals above expected
fixes_applied.fix3: min 200 EV min for C2/C3, min 60 PP/PK min for C5/C6 (z=0 below)
fixes_applied.v4_improvement1: C2 replaces SH%-above-expected with iGSAX/60 (total goals above expected per 60), captures finishing volume + skill
fixes_applied.v4_improvement2: Reweighted: RAPM 0.20, Individual 0.33, RelxG% 0.17, Playmaking 0.18 (with points/60 sub-metric), PP 0.07, PK 0.05
fixes_applied.v4_improvement3: WAR-equivalent rescale: composite_war = (raw − 20th-pct of ≥500-EV-min pool) / std(adjusted) × 0.5 wins

eh_diagnostic_improvements.R1: Component 3 split 50/50 — offensive (on-ice xGF/60 vs off-ice team xGF/60) + defensive (xGA/60, inverted). Both 40/60 blended z. Weight 0.17.
eh_diagnostic_improvements.R5: Defensemen Component 2 sub-weights: 0.25 each of ixG/60, iHDCF/60, iGSAX/60, on-ice xGA/60 (inverted). Forwards keep 0.40/0.30/0.30. Weight 0.33.
eh_diagnostic_improvements.R2: PK Component 70/30 blend — 0.70 on-ice xGA/60 inverted + 0.30 SH points/60 (G+A1+A2). Both z-scored over the PK-qualified pool. Weight 0.05.
eh_diagnostic_improvements.R4: New CSV column expected_gp_share = year-weighted GP/82 over the 3 seasons (denominator = sum of season weights * 82 = 151.7). For Phase 4 availability multipliers; does NOT modify composite_war.

accepted_tradeoff_makar: Cale Makar active #18 (was #12 pre-EH-diag) — R5 trades defensemen offensive-only credit for shared offense+defense, compressing elite-offensive D toward neutral. Explicitly approved as the methodological cost of giving shot-suppression D (Seider, Brodin, Lindell, Parayko) appropriate credit.
